events.event: Komdigi Minister Meutya Hafid said at a press conference that Komdigi has handled 67,578 online fraud contents and received public reports via AduanNomor.id, CekRekening.id and AduanKonten.id.
events.key_numbers: 67,578 fraud contents handled · 103,940 phone-number reports on AduanNomor.id (15,292 scamming, 17,631 impersonation, 19,422 extortion) · 196,624 bank-account reports on CekRekening.id · operators must block flagged numbers within 1x24 hours of a Komdigi request · Permenkomdigi 7/2026 requires biometric SIM registration
events.why_it_matters: Shows how many scam reports Indonesians file and that your SIM and bank account can be reported and blocked quickly.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by 8+ outlets (Antara, RRI, Periskop, Wartaekonomi)

events.event: CNBC Indonesia, citing the New York Times, reported that Alice Huang, an executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed International, allegedly stayed in contact with a Chinese intelligence official while involved with Jensen Huang; this is unconfirmed.
events.key_numbers: contact reportedly spring 2025 to autumn 2026 (over a year) · Megaspeed is a major Nvidia customer worth billions of dollars in chip sales · Megaspeed blacklisted over suspected chip smuggling to China · detikInet terpopuler #1 and #3 on Huang topics
events.why_it_matters: The world's most valuable chip maker's CEO saga now touches US-China chip smuggling, which affects AI chip supply and prices.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia, citing Reuters and Counterpoint, reported Xiaomi's Q3 2026 adjusted profit fell 57% as memory chip costs hit phones and global smartphone shipments dropped 20%.
events.key_numbers: adjusted net profit 4.9bn yuan (~Rp13.4tn), -57% YoY · revenue 107.2bn yuan, -5.2% · phone gross margin 9.2% vs 11.1% · Xiaomi shipments -30%+, share 12% · global shipments -20% YoY, lowest Q3 since 2012 · phone makers raised prices ~20% on average in 2026 · Xiaomi EV deliveries 100,975, -7.2%
events.why_it_matters: Explains why phones and laptops cost about 20% more this year and why that may not end soon.

events.event: Huawei's Richard Yu said HarmonyOS has passed 100 million installations, and Counterpoint data show it as number two in China ahead of iOS.
events.key_numbers: 100m+ installs · 460,000+ apps · 12m+ developers · China share Q2 2026: Android 58%, HarmonyOS 24%, iOS 18% · global: Android 75%, iOS 20%, HarmonyOS 5% · global rollout over 1-3 years
events.why_it_matters: A third phone operating system is gaining ground and may eventually reach Indonesian phones.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported China's Moore Threads is preparing a Lushan gaming GPU reportedly with 64GB VRAM, while Nvidia's RTX 5090 sells at over three times its MSRP.
events.key_numbers: Lushan up to 64GB VRAM (unofficial) · RTX 5090 32GB, US$6,599 at Newegg, 3x+ MSRP · launch expected before end 2026
events.why_it_matters: Shows memory-driven GPU price spikes are pushing a Chinese alternative.

events.event: detikInet reported the government is preparing a national task force against quantum-computing threats, and Telkom and Kemenko Polkam discussed digital sovereignty in the quantum era.
events.why_it_matters: Future quantum computers could break today's encryption on banking and ID data.

events.event: Katadata reported that Samsung Securities in South Korea was hacked, leaking data of 8,241 customers including account numbers and addresses.
events.key_numbers: 8,241 customers · account numbers, addresses and contact details exposed
events.why_it_matters: Foreign case, but a reminder that customer-support systems are a common leak point.

events.event: Katadata reported a Jakarta trader was paid Rp10,000 to train an AI robot and warned of personal data risk.
events.key_numbers: Rp10,000 per task · housewives paid to train AI (CNBC Indonesia, 24 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Ordinary people earn small sums while giving away personal data to train AI.
